rule: Two kinds of facts live here and they are never merged. INTENDED fields (intended_asin, official_listing_url, confirmation_date, confirmation_source) are filled only when the owner or an official Associates record confirms the product. OBSERVED fields (observed_*) are what an Amazon page showed on a dated fetch, and are kept separate on purpose. A blank cell means 'not confirmed', never 'guessed'. Specs come from the manufacturer page named in 'spec_sources'; where two official pages disagree, the value is left blank and a flag explains why.
